troubleshooting.title: Troubleshoot embedded help
troubleshooting.shortdesc: The usual reasons the help panel stays empty, refuses to sign in, or opens the wrong topic.

condition.title: The panel is blank, or the browser console says it refused to frame the page
condition.p: The docs server does not list your page's origin in frame-ancestors, or your own CSP blocks the frame.

cause.p: Your app's origin is missing from OPEND_EMBED_ORIGINS, or is written with a path or trailing slash.

remedy.p: Add the exact origin, such as https://console.example.com, and restart the server. Also allow the docs origin in your app's frame-src and script-src.

cause.p: Embedding is off: /embed/opend-help.js does not return the script.

The token is wrong: a different secret, an audience other than the docs site's PUBLIC_URL (watch for a trailing slash), a lifetime over 600 seconds, a missing iat, or an expired token because your server's clock is off.

remedy.p: Decode the token and check each claim against . The server logs embed token rejected with the reason.

cause.p: getToken rejected or returned something other than the bare token, such as JSON.

remedy.p: Return the token as plain text, or unwrap it in getToken.

troubleshooting.title: The panel says "You do not have access to this help."

condition.p: The token is valid, but the exchange answered 403.

cause.p: The email is not registered as a reader, or is registered in a different organization from the token's org.

remedy.p: Register the reader in the right organization. The server logs embed token for unknown reader or wrong org.

troubleshooting.title: The panel opens the wrong topic, or "No help here yet"

condition.p: The context resolves differently from what you expected.

cause.p: The route, the key or the reader's entitlements do not lead where you think.

step.cmd: Open the previewer's help lab, preview as a reader like the user, and try the same key or path.
Check that the widget's app matches the appname in the topics and help-contexts.yaml.
Remember that a hidden target falls back to the parent key or the default; see .

troubleshooting.title: The panel asks for a token on every page

condition.p: The session cookie does not stick.

cause.p: The docs site is served over plain HTTP, so the browser drops the Secure cookie, or the browser blocks partitioned third-party cookies.

remedy.p: Serve the docs site over HTTPS. For browsers that block partitioned cookies, render help from the JSON API instead.
